entities.name: Fulgencio Batista

entities.summary: Leader of Cuba (1940–1944, 1952–1959). Military strongman; US-backed; corrupt; mafia ties (Havana casinos, Lucky Luciano/Meyer Lansky); brutal repression; fled to Dominican Republic January 1, 1959
